hero.title: Healthcare Data Science Workshop
hero.description: Hands-on, intensive training in the latest data science techniques for healthcare and life sciences. From medical imaging AI to drug discovery, build practical skills with expert instructors.

topics.title: Medical Imaging AI
topics.description: Deep learning for radiology, pathology image analysis, 3D medical image segmentation, and deploying imaging models in clinical workflows.

topics.title: Genomics Analysis
topics.description: Bioinformatics pipelines, variant calling, gene expression analysis, and applying machine learning to genomic datasets for precision medicine.

topics.title: Clinical NLP
topics.description: Extracting insights from electronic health records, medical text mining, clinical trial matching, and building healthcare chatbots.

topics.title: Drug Discovery
topics.description: AI-driven molecular design, virtual screening, ADMET prediction, and accelerating the drug development pipeline with generative models.

topics.title: HIPAA Compliance & Data Privacy
topics.description: Ensuring regulatory compliance when handling patient data, de-identification techniques, and audit trail management.

topics.title: Privacy-Preserving ML
topics.description: Federated learning for multi-site studies, differential privacy, homomorphic encryption, and secure multi-party computation in healthcare.

highlights: Hands-on labs with real-world anonymised datasets
Small class sizes for personalised instruction
Certificate of completion for all attendees
Access to cloud GPU environments for workshop exercises
Take-home code repositories and reference materials
Networking dinner with healthcare data science practitioners
